title: New England Deathcore at it's finest
contentHtml:
New England’s deathcore scene is preparing for a killer new year with two bands releasing new music within a five day span of each other. Symphonic Deathcore band Shadow of Intent featuring members of both bands Currents and In Depths and Tides are releasing a full length album titled “Primordial” on January 10th. Shadow of Intent has the preorder option available on both iTunes and Bandcamp now along with a teaser of the album on YouTube that showcases 20 seconds of each track. PRY is a deathcore band based out of Connecticut is planning to release their debut EP titled “Nodus Tollens” on January 15th which you can purchase over on Chugcore’s Bandcamp the day of release, but once again there is a teaser of all tracks over on the Chugcore Facebook page for you to listen to right now.

What are your plans, do you dig either band and plan on picking up eithers new record? Leave a comment below and as always stay metal.

​
